entries.headline: Next: V3.8.0
entries.body: Adds the Mining Drill Rig: a tracked machine you ride, set down, and drill with. It clears a 5x5 face in one pass and goes through obsidian - in exchange it is very slow, and cannot move at all while drilling.

entries.headline: The V4 update
entries.body: The next major update, with 20 modules planned. It has an announcement page of its own.
